name: find_cashless_garages
description: Find Digit cashless workshops near the incident city. Call only after lookup_policy showed an active comprehensive policy with own-damage cover. Pass the verified policy_number. Use this when the caller wants a garage, asks what is nearby, or asks for the cheapest/fastest cashless option. Never call this to file a claim. If the preferred locality is full, tell the caller the recommended alternative from the response instead of inventing availability.
pre_call_message: I am checking cashless garages near you.

city.description: City of the accident, for example Bengaluru or Bangalore.

locality.description: Neighbourhood if the caller named one, for example Koramangala.

policy_number.description: Verified policy number from lookup_policy, for example POL-DGT-4821.
